a: Mishna hannoder min habbayit — muttar baaliyyay, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: aliyyay bichlal habbayit. hannoder min aliyyay — muttar bevayit.
Gemara man tena "bevet" lerabbot et hayyatzia, "bevet" lerabbot et haaliyyay? amar rav chisda: rabbi meir hi, dei rabbanan, haamri rabbanan: aliyyay bichlal habbayit, lema li kera "bevet" leribbuya?
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbanan, baaya kera. desalka datach amena "bevet eretz achuzzatchem" ketiv. dimchabbar beara — shemeh bayit, aliyyay — ha la mechabbar beara.

Keman azla ha deamar rav huna bar chiyyay mishshemeh deulla: "bayit beveti ani mocher lach" — marehu aliyyay. tama daamar leh "bayit shebbeveti ani mocher lach", aval "bayit" setam — eno marehu aliyyay. lema, rabbi meir hi? afillu tema rabbanan, may "aliyyay" — meulla shebbabbattim.
Mishna hannoder min hammitta — muttar baddargesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: dargesh bichlal mitta. hannoder min haddargesh — muttar bammitta.

Gemara may dargesh? amar ulla: arsa degadda. amaru leh rabbanan leulla, ha ditnan: keshehen mavrin oto, kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargesh. kullah shatta la yatev ale, hahu yoma yatev ale? matkef la ravina: midde dehave abbasar veyayin, dechulla shatta i bae — achel, vei bae — la achel, hahu yoma anan yahavinan leh!

Ella ha kashya, detanya: dargesh lo haya kofehu, ella zokfo. vei amrat arsa degadda hu, vehatanya: hakkofe et mittato — lo mittato bilvad hu kofe, ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch habbayit hu kofe! ha la kashya,
b: Midde dehave ammitta hameyuchedet lechelim, detanya: im hayta mitta hameyuchedet lechelim — en tzarich lichpotah.

Ella i kashya — ha kashya, detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: dargesh — mattir karbitav vehu nofel meelav. vei dargesh arsa degadda hu, karbitin mi it leh? ki ata ravin, amar: sheelteh lehahu merabbanan verav tachlifa bar mareva shemeh, dahava shechiach beshuka detzallae, veamar li: may dargesh — arsa detzalla.

Ittemar, ezehu mitta veezehu dargesh? amar rabbi yirmeya: mitta — mesargin otah al gabbah, dargesh — mesargin oto miggufo. metivi: kele etz meematay mekabbelin tumea? hammitta vehaarisa — mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. vei mitta mistareget al gabbah, lema li shifat or haddag?
Ella ha veha miggufan. mitta — aole veappoke bevizyane, dargesh — aole veappoke baavakta.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi: mitta shennakliteha yotzin, zokfah vedayyo. amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Mishna hannoder min hair — muttar likkanes litchumah shel ir, veasur likkanes leibburah. aval hannoder min habbayit — asur min haagaf velifnim.

Gemara menalan deibbura demata kemata dame? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vayhi bihyot yehoshua biricho vegomer", may biricho? illema biricho mammash, vehachtiv: "viricho sogeret umesuggeret"! ella shema minna beibburah.
Ema afillu bitchumah! ha ketiv bitchumah "umaddotem michutz lair".

Hannoder min habbayit — eno asur ella min haagaf velifnim. aval min haagaf velachutz — lo. metiv rav mari: "veyatza hakkohen min habbayit", yachol yelech leveto veyasgir — talmud lomar: "el petach habbayit". i el petach habbayit, yachol yaamod tachat hammashkof veyasgir — talmud lomar: "min habbayit", ad sheyyetze min habbayit kullo.

Ha ketzad? omed betzad hammashkof veyasgir. uminnayin sheim halach leveto vehisgir, o sheamad tachat hashshakof vehisgir, shehesgero musegar — talmud lomar: "vehisgir et habbayit", mikkol makom. shane gabbe bayit, dichtiv: "min habbayit", ad sheyyetze min habbayit kullo.

a: Mishna "kuvnnam perot haellu alay", "kuvnnam hen al pi", "kuvnnam hen lefi" — asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. "sheani ochel", vesheani toem — muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, bedavar shezzaro kale. aval bedavar sheen zaro kale — afillu giddule giddulin asurin.

Haomer leishto "kuvnnam maase yadayich alay", "kuvnnam hen al pi", "kuvnnam hen lefi" — asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. "sheani ochel", "sheani toem" — muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, bedavar shezzaro kale. aval davar sheen zaro kale — afillu giddule giddulin asurin.

"Sheat osa eni ochel ad happesach", "sheat osa eni mitkasse ad happesach", asta lifne happesach — muttar leechol ulehitkassot achar happesach. "sheat osa ad happesach eni ochel", vesheat osa ad happesach eni mitkasse", asta lifne happesach — asur leechol ulehitkassot achar happesach. "sheat nehenet li ad happesach im holechet at levet avich ad hechag", halcha lifne happesach — asura bahanaato ad happesach.
b: Leachar happesach — beval yachel". "sheat nehenet li ad hechag im holechet at levet avicha ad happesach", halcha lifne happesach — asura bahanaato ad hechag, umutteret lelech achar happesach.

Gemara haomer leishto "kuvnnam maase yadayich alay", "kuvnnam hen al pi", "kuvnnam hen lefi vechulei", yishmael ish kefar yamma, veamri la ish kefar deyamma, heela beyado batzal sheakaro bashsheviit, unetao bashsheminit, verabbu giddulav al ikkaro. vehachi ka mibbaya leh: giddulav hetter veikkaro asur, kevan deravu giddulav meikkaro — otan giddule hetter maalin et haissur, o la? ata lekammeh derabbi amme la hava bideh.

Ata lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha, peshat leh min hada deamar rabbi chanina teritaa amar rabbi yannay: batzal shel teruma shennetao, verabbu giddulav al ikkaro — muttar. amar leh rabbi yirmeya veittema rabbi zerika: shavek mar teren veaved kechad?!
Man ninhu teren? deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: yalda shessibbechah bizkenah, uvah perot, af al pi shehosifa matayim — asur.
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar rabbi nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: batzal shennetao bakkerem, veneekar hakkerem — asur.
Hadar ata lekammeh derabbi amme ufeshayt leh min hada deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: litra betzalim shettikkena uzeraah, mitasseret lefi chullah. alma otan giddulin mevattelin ikkar.
Dilma lechumera shane.
Ella, min hada detanya, rabbi shimon omer:

a: Kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, kegon tevel umaaser sheni vehekdesh vechadash — lo natnu bahen chachamim shiur. vechol davar sheen lo mattirin, kegon teruma uterumat maaser vechalla veorla vechile hakkerem — natnu bahem chachamim shiur.
Amru lo: vahalo sheviit en lah mattirin, velo natnu bah chachamim shiur. ditnan: hashsheviit oseret kol shehu beminah! amar lahen: af ani lo amarti ella leviur.
Aval laachila benoten taam. vedilma ha name lechumera shane!
Ella min hada pashta, ditnan: betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim vetzamchu, im hayu alin shellahen shechorin — asurin. horiku — muttarin.
Rabbi chananya ben antignos omer: im yecholin littalesh bealin shellahen — asurin. uchenegdan, lemotzae sheviit — muttarin. lememra degiddule hetter maalin et haissur. vedilma bimdukkanin.
Ella min hada, detanya:
b: Hamenakkesh im hakkuti bachasiyyot — ochel mehen achilat aray, umeasseran vadday.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im yisrael chashud al hashsheviit, lemotzae sheviit — muttar. lememra degiddule hetter maalin et haissur, vedilma bedavar shezzaro kale? ha tanya: ellu hen chasiyyot — kegon halluf hashshum vehabbetzalim.
Vedilma bimdukkanin? "chashud al hashsheviit" katane. vedilma betaarovet? hamenakkesh katane.
Lema tehve teyuveteh derabbi yochanan uderabbi yonatan! amar rabbi yitzchak: shanya sheviit, hoil veissurah al yede karka — betilatah name al yede karka.

Hare maaser, deissuro al yede karka, veen betilato al yede karka. detanya: litra maaser tevel shezzeraah bakkarka vehishbicha, vahare hi keeser litrin — chayyevet bemaaser uvishviit. veotah litra, measser aleha mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon!

a: Amri: maaser, diggun hu deka garem leh.

Metiv rame bar chama: "kuvnnam perot haellu alay", "kuvnnam hen al pi", "kuvnnam hen lefi" — asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. "sheani ochel", vesheani toem" — muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen bedavar shezzaro kale, aval bedavar sheen zaro kale — afillu giddule giddulin asurin.
Amar rabbi abba: shane konamot, hoil vei bae mitteshil alayyhu — havu lehu kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin, veen batel barov.

Vahare teruma, dei bae mitteshil ala, uvatli berov. ditnan: sea teruma temea shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin — terakev. ha lemea — taale! amri: bitruma beyad kohen askinan, dela matze mitteshil ala.
I hachi, ema sefa: im hayta tehora timmacher lechohen! ella beyisrael shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen askinan.
[Veha] katane sefa: timmacher lechohen chutz middeme otah sea?

Ella ema: bishlama kunnamot — mitzva leitteshole alehen, mishshum derabbi natan. deamar rabbi natan: kol hannoder — keillu bana bama, vehamekayyeymo — keillu maktir aleha. teruma may mitzva leitteshole ala?

Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan: litra betzalim shettikkenah uzeraah — mitasseret lefi chullah. yatev rabba vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh rav chisda: man tzaet lach ulerabbi yochanan rabbach! hetter shebbahen lehechan halach? amar leh: mi la tenan dichvota: betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim vetzimmechu,
b: Im hayu alin shellahen shechorin — asurin, horiku — muttarin. vechi shechorin ammay asurin? lema: hetter shebbahen lehechan halach? amar leh: mi savrat al ikkar katane? attosefet katane asurin. i hachi, may ata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar? detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: haggadel bechiyyuv — chayyayv, haggadel biftur — patur. tanna kamma name hachi amar!
Kullah matnitin rabban shimon ben gamliel katane la. vead kan la shamat leh lerabban shimon ben gamliel dela ka tarach, aval hecha deka tarach — batel berubba.

Vechol hecha deka tarach batel berubba? vahare litra maaser tevel, dekatarach, vekatane: veotah litra measser alav mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon! shane gabbe maaser, deamar kera "asser teasser vegomer", vehettera — zari inashe, issura — la zari inashe.
Gufa, amar rabbi chanina tirtaa amar rabbi yannay: batzal shel teruma shennetao, verabbu giddulav al ikkaro — muttar. lememra degiddule

a: Hetter maalin et haissur? vehatnan: giddule teruma teruma! begiddule giddulin kaamrinan. ha name tenena: giddule giddulin chullin! ha ka mashma lan: afillu bedavar sheen zaro kale.
Vehatnan: hattevel — giddulav muttarin bedavar shezzaro kale. aval davar sheen zaro kale — giddule giddulin asurin! ribbuya derabbu giddulin al ikkaro muttar ka mashma lan.
Haderan alach hannoder min hayyarak
"Kunnam yayin sheani toem hayyom" — eno asur ella ad shettechshach. "shabbat zo" — asur bechol hashshabbat, veshabbat sheavra. "chodesh ze" — asur bechol hachodesh, verosh chodesh lehabba.
"Shana zo" — asur bechol hashshana, verosh hashshana leatid lavo. "shavua ze" — asur bechol hashshavua, usheviit sheavra.
Veim amar "yom echad", "shabbat achat", "chodesh echad", "shana achat", "shavua echad" — asur miyyom leyom.
"Ad happesach" — asur ad sheyyaggia, "ad sheyyehe" — asur ad sheyyetze. "ad lifne happesach", rabbi meir omer: asur ad sheyyaggia, rabbi yose omer: asur ad sheyyetze.
Gemara kunnam yayin sheani toem kulei. amar rabbi yirmeya: lichshettecheshach tzarich sheela lechacham.
May tama? amar rav yosef: gezera "hayyom" mishshum "yom echad".
b: Amar leh: i hachi, ligzor beyom echad" mishshum "hayyom"!
Amar leh: "hayyom" beyom echad" michallaf, "yom echad" behayyom" la michallaf.

Amar ravina: amar li marimar, hachi amar avuch mishshemeh derav [yosef]: keman azla shemateh derav yirmeya bar abba — kerabbi natan. detanya, rabbi natan omer: kol hannoder — keillu bana bama, vehamekayyeymo — keillu maktir aleha.
"Shabbat zo" — asur bechol hashshabbat kullah. peshita! mahu detema: yome deshabbeta kaamar, ka mashma lan.
"Chodesh ze" — asur bechol hachodesh, verosh chodesh lehabba. peshita! ki itztericha lechodesh chaser,
Mahu detema: rosh chodesh lesheavar have, vela littesar, ka mashma lan karu inashe resh yarcha.
"Shana zo" — asur bechol hashshana kullah.
Ibbaya lehu, amar: "kuvnnam yayin sheani toem yom" — may dineh? kehayyom", o keyom echad"?
Ta shema mimmatnitin: "kuvnnam yayin sheani toem hayyom" — en asur ella ad shettechshach. ha "yom" keyom echad" dame.
Ema sefa, amar: "yom echad" — asur miyyom leyom. ha "yom" kehayyom" dame. ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Amar rav ashe, ta shema: "kuvnnam yayin sheani toem hashshana", nitabbera hashshana — asur bah uveibburah. hechi dame?

a: Illema kidkatane — lema li lememra? ella lav, daamar "shana". alma "shana" kehashshana" dame, veyom" name kehayyom" dineh.
La, leolam deamar "hashshana", umahu detema: hallech achar rov hashshanim, vela it behu ibbur, ka mashma lan.
Ibbaya lehu: amar "yayin sheani toem yovel" may? shenat chamishshim kelifne chamishshim, o kilachar chamishshim?

Ta shema, detanya pelugeta derabbi yehuda verabbanan: "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana". shenat hachamishshim atta mone, vei atta mone shenat chamishshim veachat. mikkan amru: yovel eno ole leminyan shavua. rabbi yehuda omer: yovel ole leminyan shavua.
Amru lo lerabbi yehuda: hare hu omer "shesh shanim tizra sadecha", veen kan ella chamesh!
Amar lahem: ledivrechem, hare hu omer "veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim". hare kan arba!
Ella — ikka leokoma bishar shene shavua, dili name ikka leokoma bishar shene shavua.
"Ad happesach" — asur kulei. lememra derabbi meir savar: la meayyel inish nafsheh
b: Lisfeka, verabbi yose savar: meayyel inish nafsheh lisfeka.

Ureminhi: mi sheyyesh lo shete kitte vanot mishte nashim, veamar: kiddashti et bitti haggedola, veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot, im gedola shebbakketannot, veim ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot — kullan asurot, divre rabbi meir. chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot.
Rabbi yose omer: kullan muttarot, chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot.
Amar rabbi chanina bar avdimi amar rav: muchelefet hashshita. vehatanya, ze hakkelal: kol shezzemanno kavua veamar "ad lifne" — rabbi meir omer: ad sheyyetze, verabbi yose omer: ad sheyyaggia.

Mishna "ad hakkatzir", "ad habbatzir", "ad hammasik" — eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia. ze hakkelal: kol shezzemanno kavua, veamar: "ad sheyyaggia" — asur ad sheyyaggia. amar: "ad sheyyehe" — asur ad sheyyetze. vechol sheen zemanno kavua, ben amar "ad sheyyehe", ben amar "ad sheyyaggia" — eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia.
"Ad hakkayitz", "ad sheyyehe hakkayitz" — ad sheyyatchilu haam lehachenis bechalkallot. "ed sheyyaavor hakkayitz" — ad sheyyakpilu hammiktzoot.
Gemara tana: "kalkalla" sheamru — kalkalla shel teenim, velo kalkalla shel anavim. tanya: hannoder mipperot hakkayitz — en asur ella bitenim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: anavim bichlal teenim.
May tama detanna kamma? kasavar: teenim mikkatztzan bida, anavim la mikkatztzan bida. rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: anavim name, ki miraddedan — mikkatztzan bida.
"Ad sheyyaavor hakkayitz", ad sheyyikkaflu hammaktzuot. tana: ad sheyyachpilu rov hammaktzuot.

a: Tana: hukeplu rov hammaktzuot — muttarot mishshum gezel, ufeturot min hammaasrot.

Rabbi verabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda ikkelau lehahu atra bizman shehukeplu rov hammaktzuot, rabbi hava ka achel, rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda la achel. ata marhon, amar lehu: ammay la achli rabbanan? hukeplu rov hammaktzuot hu! veaf al pi chen la achel rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda, kasavar: mishshum sanyut milleta hu dekaamar haden gavra.

Rabbi chama bar rabbi chanina ikkela lehahu atra bizman shehukeplu rov hammaktzuot, hava kaachel, yahev leshammaeh la achel. amar leh: echol, kach amar li rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose mishshum aviv: hukeplu rov hammaktzuot — muttarot mishshum gezel ufeturot min hammaaser.

Rabbi tarfon ashkecheh hahu gavra bizman shehukeplu hammaktzuot dekaachel. achateh besakka veshakleh veamteyeh lemishdeh benahara. amar lo: oy lo letarfon shezze horgo! shema hahu gavra shavkeh vaarak. amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chananya ben gamliel: kol yamav shel oto tzaddik haya mitztaer al davar ze, amar: oy li shennishtammashti bechitrah shel tora.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora nekar min haolam. kal vachomer: uma belshatztzar shennishtammesh bichle kodesh shennaasu kele chol, shenneemar: "uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha", kevan shepperatzum naasu chol — nekar min haolam, dichtiv: "be belelya ketil belshatztzar", hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora, shehu chay vekayyaym leolam — al achat kamma vechamma.

Verabbi tarfon, kevan dechi achel dehukeplu rov hammaktzuot hava, ammay tzaareh hahu gavra? mishshum dehahu havo ganvi leh inve kulla shatta, vechevan deashkecheh lerabbi tarfon savar: hayeynu deganvan. i hachi ammay tzayar nafsheh? mishshum derabbi tarfon ashir gadol hava, vahava leh lefayyeyso bedamim.
Tanya: "leahava et Adonai elohecha lishmoa bekolo uledovka vo", shello yomar adam: ekra sheyyikrauni "chacham", eshne sheyyikrauni "rabbi", ashannen sheehye zaken veeshev bishiva.

Ella lemad meahava, vesof hakkavod lavo. shenneemar: "koshrem al etzbeotecha kotvem al luach libbecha". veomer: "deracheha darche noam", veomer: "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vetomcheha meushshar".

Rabbi eliezer bar rabbi tzadok omer: ase devarim leshem poolam, vedabber bahem lishmam. al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem, veal taasem kuredom lihyot oder bo. vekal vachomer: uma belshatztzar shello nishtammesh ella bichle kodesh shennaasu kele chol — nekar min haolam, hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora — al achat kamma vechamma.
Amar rava: shere leh leinish leodoe nafsheh beatra dela yadi leh — dichtiv: "veavdecha yare et Adonai minneurav", ella kashya derabbi tarfon! ashir gadol haya, vahava leh lefayyoyseh bedamim.
Rava rame, ketiv: "veavdecha yare et Adonai minneurav", uchetiv: "yehallelcha zar velo ficha"! ha — beatra deyadi leh, ha — beatra dela yadi leh.

Amar rava: shere leh letzureba merabbanan lememar "tzureba merabbanan ana, shero li tigray beresha", dichtiv: "uvene david kohanim hayu" — ma kohen notel barosh, af talmid chacham notel barosh. vechohen mena lan? dichtiv: "vekiddashto ki et lechem (Adonai) elohecha hu makriv", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: "vekiddashto" — lechol davar shebbikdushsha,
b: Liftoach rishon, ulevarech rishon, velittol mana yafa rishon.

Amar rava: shere leh letzureba merabbanan lememar: la yahevna akkeraga, dichtiv "minda velo vahalach la shallit lemirme alehon". veamar rabbi yehuda: "minda" — zo menat hammelech, "belo" — zo kesef guvlgalta, "vahalach" — zo arnona.
Veamar rava: shere leh letzureba merabbanan lememar: "avda denura ana la yahevna akkeraga". may tama — leavroche arya minneh kaamar.
Rav ashe hava leh hahu ibba, zabbeneh leve nura. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: haikka "lifne ivver lo titten michshol"! amar leh: rov etzim lehassaka nittenu.
Mishna "ad hakkatzir" — ad sheyyatchil heam liktzor ketzir chittin, aval lo ketzir seorin, hakkol lefi mekom nidro. im haya bahar — bahar, veim haya babbika — babbika.

"Ad haggeshamim", "ad sheyyehu haggeshamim" — ad shettered revia sheniyya. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ad sheyyaggia zemannah shel revia. "ad sheyyifseku geshamim" — ad sheyyetze nisan kullo, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyaavor happesach.
Gemara tanya: hannoder "ad hakkayitz" baggalil, veyarad laamakim, af al pi shehiggia hakkayitz baamakim — asur ad sheyyaggia hakkayitz baggalil.

"Ad haggeshamim", "ad sheyyehu geshamim" — ad shettered revia sheniyya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. amar rabbi zera: machaloket deamar "ad haggeshamim", aval amar "ad haggeshem" — ad zeman geshamim kaamar.

a: Metivi: ezohi zemannah shel revia? habbechira — bishlosha, benonit — beshiva, afila — beesrim ushelosha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshiva, uveshiva asar, uveesrim ushelosha.
Rabbi yose omer: beshiva asar, uveesrim ushelosha, uvechodesh kislev. vechen haya rabbi yose omer: en hayyechidim mitannin ad sheyyaggia rosh chodesh kislev.
Veamrinan ala: bishlama revia rishona — lishshael. shelishit — lehitannot. ella sheniyya lemay? veamar rabbi zera: lenoder.
Veamrinan ala: keman azla ha detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: geshamim sheyyardu shiva yamim ze achar ze — atta mone bahen revia rishona usheniyya. keman? kerabbi yose!
Hahu deamar "ad haggeshamim".
Mishna "kuvnnam yayin sheeni toem leshana", nitabbera hashshana — asur bah uveibburah. "ad rosh adar" — ad rosh adar harishon. "ad sof adar" — ad sof adar harishon.
Gemara alma setama daadar" dekaamar — rishon hu.

Lema matnitin rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: adar harishon — kotev "adar harishon", adar sheni — kotev "adar" setam, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: adar harishon — kotev setam, adar sheni — kotev "tinyayn".
Amar abbaye: afillu tema rabbi meir, ha deyada dimabbera shatta, ha dela yada.
b: Vehatanya: "ad rosh chodesh adar" — ad rosh chodesh adar harishon, im hayta shana meubberet — ad rosh chodesh adar hashsheni.
Mikkelal deresha lav bimubberet askinan?! shema minna: ha difshita leh dimabbera shatta, ha dela yada.
Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: "kuvnnam yayin sheeni toem ad sheyyehe happesach" — lo nitkavvevn ze ella ad lel happesach, ad shaa shedderech bene adam lishtot yayin.

Amar "kuvnnam basar sheeni toem ad sheyyehe hatztzom" — eno asur ella ad lele tzom, shello nitkavvevn ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol basar. rabbi yose beno omer: "kuvnnam shum sheani toem ad shettehe shabbat", eno asur ella ad lele shabbat, shello nitkavvevn ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol beshum.

Haomer lachavero "kuvnnam sheani nehene lecha im en at ba venotel levanecha kor echad shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin" — hare ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham. veyomar lo: kelum amarta ella mippene chevodi — zehu kevodi.

Vechen haomer lachavero "kuvnnam sheat nehenet li im en at ba venoten livni kor shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin", rabbi meir omer: asur ad sheyyitten, vachachamim omrim: af ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham, veyomar lo: hare ani keillu nitkabbalti.

Haya mesarev bo laset bat achoto, veamar "kuvnnam shehi nehenet li leolam", vechen hamegaresh et ishto, omer "kuvnnam ishti nehenet li leolam" — hare ellu muttarot lehanot lo, shello nitkavvevn ze ella leshum ishut.

Haya mesarev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo, amar: "kuvnnam levetcha sheani nichnas, tippat tzonen sheani toem lach" — muttar likkanes leveto velishtot mimmennu tzonen, shello nitkavvevn ze ella leshum achila ushetiyya.
Hadaran alach kuvnnam yayin

a: Rabbi eliezer omer: potchin leadam bichvod aviv veimmo, vachachamim osrin.

Amar rabbi tzadok: ad sheppotchin lo bichvod aviv veimmo, yiftechu lo bichvod hammakom, im ken — en nedarim! modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bedavar shebbeno leven aviv veimmo, sheppotchin lo bichvod aviv veimmo.

Veod amar rabbi eliezer: potchin bannolad, vachachamim osrin. ketzad? amar: "kuvnnam sheani nehene leish peloni" venaasa sofer, o shehaya massi et beno, veamar: "illu hayiti yodea shehu naase sofer o shehaya massi et beno bekarov — lo hayiti noder".
"Kuvnnam levayit ze sheani nichnas" venaasa bet hakkeneset, amar: "illu hayiti yodea shehu naasa bet hakkeneset — lo hayiti noder". rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin.
Gemara may "en nedarim"? amar abbaye: im ken, en nedarim nittarin yafe.
b: Verava amar: im ken en nedarim nishalin lechacham.

Tenan: umodin chachamim lerabbi eliezer bedavar shebbeno leven aviv veimmo, sheppotchim lo bichvod aviv veimmo. bishlama leabbaye deamar: im ken en nedarim nittarin, hacha kevan deichatzaf leh — ha ichatzaf leh.
Ella lerava, deamar: im ken en nedarim nishalin lechacham, hacha ammay potchin? amri: kevan dechol nidre la saggi lehon delav chacham — hacha name potchin.
Veod amar rabbi eliezer potchin bannolad kulei. may tama derabbi eliezer? amar rav chisda: deamar kera "ki metu kol haanashim" — veha mita denolad hu, mikkan sheppotchin bannolad.

Verabbanan may tamayyhu? kasavri: hanhu mi mayyti? veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol makom shenneemar "nitztzim" venitztzavim", enan ella datan vaaviram. ella amar resh lakish: sheyyardu minnichsehen.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol adam sheen lo banim — chashuv kemet, shenneemar: "hava li vanim veim ayin meta anochi". vetanya, arbaa chashuvin met: ani, umetzora, vesome, umi sheen lo banim. ani — dichtiv: "ki metu kol haanashim". metzora — dichtiv: "al na tehi kammet". vesome — dichtiv: "bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam". umi sheen lo banim — dichtiv: "hava li vanim veim ayin meta anochi".

a: Tanya: hammuddar hanaa mechavero en mattirin lo ella befanav. mena hane mille? amar rav nachman: dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe bemidyan lech shuv mitzrayim ki metu kol haanashim". amar lo: bemidyan nadarta — lech vehatter nidrecha bemidyan. dichtiv: "vayyoel moshe" — en ala ella shevua, dichtiv: "vayyave oto beala".

"Vegam bammelech nevuchadnetztzar marad asher hishbio belohim (chayyim)". may marduteh? ashkecheh tzidkiyya linvuchadnetztzar dahava kaachel arneva chayya. amar leh: ishteva li dela megallet illavay vela tippok milleta. ishteva.

Lesof hava ka mitztaar tzidkiyyahu begufeh. itteshil ashshevuateh, vaamar. shema nevuchadnetztzar deka mevazzin leh, shelach veayyti sanhedrin vetzidkiyyahu. amar lehon: chazetun may ka aved tzidkiyyahu? lav hachi ishteva bishma dishmayya dela megallena"? amar leh: itteshali ashshevuata.

[Amar lehu: mittashlin ashshevuata?] amri leh: in. amar lehu: befanav, o afillu shello befanav? amri leh: befanav. amar lehon: veattun may avditun, may tama la amritun letzidkiyyahu? miyyad "yeshvu laaretz yiddemu zikne vat tziyyon". amar rabbi yitzchak: sheshshamtu karim mittachtehem.

Mishna rabbi meir omer: yesh devarim shehen kannolad veenan kannolad, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad? amar "kuvnnam sheani nose et pelonit, sheaviha ra", amru lo: met, o sheasa teshuva. "kuvnnam levayit ze sheani nichnas, shehakkelev ra betocho", o "shehannachash betocho", amru lo: met hakkelev, o shenneherag hannachash — hare hen kannolad, veeno kannolad. veen chachamim modim lo.
Gemara "kuvnnam sheani nichnas levayit ze shehakkelev vechulei" — met nolad hu! amar rav huna: naasa ketole nidro bedavar. verabbi yochanan amar: kevar met uchevar asa teshuva, kaamri leh.
b: Metiv rabbi abba: "kuvnnam sheeni nose liflonit keura", vahare hi naa. "shechora", vahare hi levana. "ketzara", vahare hi arukka — muttar bah. lo mippene shekkeura venaaset nae, shechora venaaset levana, ketzara venaaset arukka — ella shehanneder taut. bishlama lerav huna deamar naasa ketole nidro bedavar: tena tole nidro bedavar, utena neder taut. ella lerabbi yochanan, deamar kevar met uchevar asa teshuva, lema li lemitne tere zimne neder taut? kashya.

Mishna veod amar rabbi meir: potchin lo min hakkatuv shebbattora, veomrin lo: illu hayita yodea sheatta over al "lo tikkom", veal "lo tittor", veal "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha", "veahavta lereacha kamocha", "veche achicha immach", shehu ani veen atta yachol lefarnaso. amar: illu hayiti yodea shehu ken, lo hayiti noder — hare ze muttar.

Gemara amar lehu rav huna bar rav kattina lerabbanan: nema, kol demiane lav alay nafel. may demate li lefarneso — bahade kulle alma mefarnasna leh. amri leh: ani omer kol hannofel, eno nofel lide gabbay techilla.
Mishna potchin laadam bichtubbat ishto.

Umaase beechad shennadar meishto hanaa, vehayta ketubbatah arba meot dinarim. uva lifne rabbi akiva, vechiyyeyvo litten lah ketubbatah. amar lo: rabbi, shemone meot dinarin hinniach abba. natal achi arba meot, vaani arba meot. lo dayya shettittol hi matayim vaani matayim? amar lo rabbi akiva: afillu atta mocher sear roshcha — atta noten lah ketubbatah. amar lo: illu hayiti yodea shehu ken — lo hayiti noder. vehittirah rabbi akiva.
Gemara mittaltele mi mishtabedi lichtuva? amar abbaye: karka shava shemone meot dinar. vehakatane: "sear rosho", usear rosho mittaltele hu! hachi kaamar: afillu atta mocher sear roshcha veochel.
Shamat minna en mesadderin levaal chov? amar rav nachman berabbi yitzchak:

a: Lomar sheen mekarin shetar ketubba.
Mishna potchin beyamim tovim uveshabbatot. barishona hayu omrim: otan hayyamim — muttarin, ushear kol hayyamim asurin. ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed shehanneder shehuttar mikkelalo — huttar kullo.
Ketzad? amar "kuvnnam sheeni nehene lechullechem", huttar echad mehen — hutteru kullan.
"Sheeni nehene laze velaze", huttar harishon — hutteru kullan, huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullan asurin. huttar haemtzai, hemennu ulematta — muttar, hemennu ulemala — asur.
"Sheani nehene laze korban velaze korban" — tzerichin petach lechol echad veechad.

"Kuvnnam yayin sheani toem, shehayyayin ra lammeayim", amru lo: vahalo hameyushshan yafe lammeayim! huttar bimyushshan. velo bimyushshan bilvad huttar, ella bechol hayyayin. "kuvnnam batzal sheeni toem, shehabbatzal ra lallev", amru lo: halo hakkuferi yafe lallev! huttar bakkuferi. velo bakkuferi bilvad huttar, ella bechol habbetzalim. maase haya, vehittiro rabbi meir bechol habbetzalim.
Gemara huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar, vechullan asurin. man tanna?
Amar rava: rabbi shimon hi, deamar: ad sheyyomar "shevua" lechol echad veechad.
Kuvnnam yayin sheani toem vechulei. vetippok leh deen ra! amar rabbi abba: veod, "yafe" katane.
Kuvnnam batzal sheani toem shehabbatzal vechulei. vetippok leh deen ra! amar rabbi abba: veod, "yafe" katane.

Mishna potchin laadam bichvod atzmo uvichvod banav. omrim lo: illu hayita yodea shellemachar omrin alecha "kach hi vivsto shel peloni, megaresh et nashav", veal benotecha yehu omrin "benot gerushot hen", "ma raata imman shel ellu lehitgaresh". veamar: "illu hayiti yodea shekken, lo hayiti noder" — hare ze muttar.

"Kuvnnam sheani nose et pelonit keura" vahare hi naa, "shechora" vahare hi levana, "ketzara" vahare hi arukka — muttar bah. lo mippene shehi keura venaaset naa, shechora venaaset levana, ketzara venaaset arukka — ella shehanneder taut.
Umaase beechad shennadar mibbat achoto hanayay, vehichnisuha levet rabbi yishmael veyippuha. amar lo rabbi yishmael: beni, mizzo nadarta? amar lo: lav, vehittirah rabbi yishmael.

Beotah shaa bacha rabbi yishmael veamar: benot yisrael naot hen, ella shehaaniyyut menavvavltan. ucheshemmet rabbi yishmael hayu benot yisrael nosot kina, veomrot: "benot yisrael al rabbi yishmael bechena", vechen hu omer beshaul: "benot yisrael al shaul bechena".

Gemara maase listor?! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: rabbi yishmael omer: afillu keura venaaset naa, shechora venaaset levana, ketzara venaaset arukka. maase beechad shennadar mibbat achoto vehichnisuha levet rabbi yishmael veyippuha vechulei.
b: Tana: shen totevet hayta lah, veasa lah rabbi yishmael shen shel zahav mishshello. ki shechev rabbi yishmael, petach aleh hahu safdana hachi: "benot yisrael al rabbi yishmael bechena hammalbishchen vechulei".

Hahu daamar la lidvethu "kuvnnam shei at nehenet li ad shettatimi tavshilech lerabbi yehuda ulerabbi shimon". rabbi yehuda teem, amar, kal vachomer: uma laasot shalom ben ish leishto amra tora shemi shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim hamearrim besafek, vaani al achat kamma vechamma.
Rabbi shimon la teem, amar: yamutu kol bene almana, veal yazuz shimon mimmekomo. veod: ki hechi dela litraggeli lemindar.

Hahu deamar lidvethu "kuvnnam shei at nehenet li ad shettarokki bo berabban shimon ben gamliel". atat urekak allevusheh. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: veha hay leziluta ka mikkavven! amar leh: mirak al mane derabban shimon ben gamliel ziluta rabbeta hi.
Hahu daamar lidvethu "kuvnnam shei at nehenet li ad shettari mum yafe shebbich lerabbi yishmael berabbi yose".

Amar lahem: shemma roshah nae? amru lo: segalgal. shemma searah nae? dome laanitze pishtan. shemma eneha naot? terutot hen. shemma ozneha naot? kefulot hen. shemma chotmah nae? balum hu. shemma siftoteha naot? avot hen. shemma tzavvarah nae? shakut hu. shemma keresah nae? tzave hu. shemma ragleha naot? rechavot keshel avoza. shemma shemah nae? "lichluchit" shemah. amar lahen: yafe korin otah lichluchit, shehi meluchelechet bemumin, vesharyay.

Hahu bar bavel dislek leara deyisrael, nesev itteta. amar la: bashshili li tere talfe. bashshila leh tere talfe. retach ala. limchar amar la: bashshili li geriva. bashshila leh geriva. amar la: zili ayyti li tere vutzine. azalat veayytay leh tere sherage.

Amar la: zili tevari yathon al resha devava. hava yatev bava ben buta abbava veka daen dina. azalat utevarat yathon al resheh. amar la: ma haden daavadt? amara leh: kach tzivvani bali. amar: at asit retzon balich, hammakom yotzi mimmech shene banim kevava ben buta.
Haderan alach rabbi eliezer
Naara hameorasa, aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha.

a: Hefer haav velo hefer habbaal, hefer habbaal velo hefer haav — eno mufar. veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehen.
Gemara hayeynu resha: aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha! mahu detema: o aviha o valah katane, ka mashma lan.
Veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehen. lema li lemitna? hasheta yesh lomar hefer ze belo ze — velo kelum, kiyyem echad mehen lema li? tzericha lemitne?!
Ki itzterich leh kegon dehefer echad mehen vekiyyem echad, vechazar hamekayyem venishal al hakamato. mahu detema: may deoki ha akreh, ka mashma lan dimfirin shenehem bevat achat.

Venaara hameorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha, menalan? amar rabba, amar kera: "veim hayo tihye leish unedareha aleha". mikkan lenaara hameorasa sheaviha uvalah mefirin nedareha. ema hay kera binsua ketiv!
I mishshum nesua, kera acharina ketiv: "veim bet ishah nadara". ema tarvayyhu binsua?! vechi tema tere kerae binsua lema li — lememar sheen habbaal mefer bekodmin.
b: Velav mimmela shamat minna?
Ibbaet ema, dahavaya kiddushin mashma.
Ema av lechodeh mefer! im ken "veasra issar bet aviha", "yani otah" lema li? hasheta yesh lomar bimkom arus mefer av lechodeh, shello bimkom arus, mibbaya?
Ema av live arus, vearus lechodeh mefer. vechi tema: av dichtav rachamana lema li, mibbee leh dei hekim — hekim!
Im ken, "bet ishah nadara" lemay ketiv? kal vachomer: uma bimkom av arus mefer lechodeh, shello bimkom av mibbaya?!
Ema: "im bet ishah nadara", lomar sheen habbaal mefer bekodmin!
Uminneh, arus mefer bekodmin.
Ella lav mishshum shuttafuteh deav.

a: Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "ben ish leishto ben av levitto", mikkan lenaara hameorasa sheaviha uvalah mefirin nedareha. uletana deve rabbi yishmael, "im hayo tihye leish" may aved leh?
Mokem leiddach derava. verava, hay detane deve rabbi yishmael may aved leh? mibbee leh lomar shehabbaal mefer nedarim shebbeno levenah.
Ibbaya lehu: baal miggaz gayez, o miklaysh kalesh? hecha ka mibbaya lan: kegon dindara mitteren zetin ushema arus vehefer la, vaachaltinnun.
I amrinan miggaz gayez — lakyay. i amrinan miklaysh kalesh — issura bealma hu. may?

Ta shema: ematay amru met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav — bizman shello shama habbaal kodem sheyyamut, o sheshshama veshatak, o sheshshama vehefer umet bo bayyom. zo hi sheshshaninu: met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav.
b: Aval im shama vekiyyem, o sheshshama veshatak umet bayyom shelleacharav — en yachol lehafer.

Shama aviha vehefer lah, velo hispik baal lishmoa ad shemmet haav — zo hi sheshshaninu: met haav, lo nitrokna reshut labbaal. shama balah vehefer lah, velo hispik haav lishmoa ad shemmet habbaal — zo hi sheshshaninu: met habbaal, nitrokna reshut laav.
Shama balah vehefer lah, velo hispik haav lishmoa ad shemmet — en habbaal yachol lehafer, sheen habbaal mefer ella beshuttafut.

a: Shama aviha vehefer lah, velo hispik habbaal lishmoa ad shemmet — chozer haav umefer chelko shel baal. amar rabbi natan: hen hen divre bet shammay. bet hillel omrim: en yachol lehafer.
Shema minna: levet shammay miggaz gayez, levet hillel miklash kalesh. shema minna.
Bae rava: yesh sheela behakem, o en sheela behakem? im timtza lomar yesh sheela behakem: yesh sheela behafer, o en sheela behafer?
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan: nishalin al hehakem, veen nishalin al hehafer.
Bae rabba: "kayyaym lichi, kayyaym lichi", venishal al hakama rishona, mahu?
Ta shema, deamar rava: im nishal al harishona — sheniyya chala alav. bae rabba: "kayyaym lichi, umufar lichi, vela techul hakama ella im ken chala hafara", mahu?
b: Ta shema mippelugeta derabbi meir verabbi yose. ditnan: "hare zo temurat ola temurat shelamim" — hare zo temurat ola, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose omer: im lechach nitkavven mittechilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keechad — devarav kayyaymin.
Vaafillu rabbi meir la kaamar, dela amar "la techul zo ella im ken chala zo", aval hacha deamar "lo techul hakama ella im ken chala hafara" — rabbi meir name mode dahafara chala.
Bae rabba: "kayyaym umufar lichi" bevat achat, mahu? ta shema deamar rabba: kol davar sheeno beze achar ze, afillu bevat achat eno.
Bae rabba: "kayyaym lichi hayyom", mahu? mi amrinan: keman daamar la "mufar lichi lemachar", o dilma ha la amar la?

a: Im timtza lomar ha la amar la, amar la "mufar lichi lemachar", mahu? mi amrinan: limchar la matze mefar, deha kayyeymeh lenidray hayyom, o dilma: kevan dela amar la "kayyaym lichi hayyom", ki kaamar la "mufar lichi lemachar", mehayyom kaamar.

Veim timtza lomar afillu hachi, kevan dekiyyeymo hayyom — limchar keman deiteh dame, amar la "kayyaym lichi shaa", mahu? mi amrinan: keman daamar la "mufar lichi leachar shaa" dame, o dilma: ha la amar lah?
Im timtza lomar ha la amar la, mihu amar la, may? mi amrinan: kevan dekiyyeymo kiyyeymo, o dilma: kevan dechulleh yoma bar hakama uvar hafara hu, ki amar "mufar lichi leachar shaa" mahne?

Ta shema: "hareni nezira", veshama balah veamar "vaani" — en yachol lehafer. veammay? nema "vaani" deamar hu al nafsheh dehave nazir, aval "hareni nezira" dila, deshaa achat kayyeyma, leachar shaa i bae — lefar, ammay en yachol lehafer? lav mishshum dechevan shekkiyyeymo — kiyyeymo? la, kasavar: kol "vaani" — keman deamar "kayyaym lichi leolam" dame.
Mishna met haav — lo nitrokna reshut labbaal. met habbaal — nitrokna reshut laav. baze yippa koach haav mikkoach habbaal.
Bedavar acher yippa koach habbaal mikkoach haav: shehabbaal mefer bivgar, vehaav eno mefer bivgar.
Gemara may tama — deamar kera "binureha bet aviha".
Met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav menalan? amar rabba: deamar kera "veim hayo tihye leish unedareha aleha" —
b: Makkish kodme havaya sheniyya lekodme havaya rishona. ma kodme havaya rishona — av mefar lechodeh, af kodme havaya sheniyya — av mefar lechodeh.
Ema hane mille bindarim shello niru laarus. aval bindarim shenniru laarus — la matze mefar av!
I bindarim shello niru laarus — mibbinureha bet aviha" nafka.
Baze yippa koach haav mikkoach habbaal kulei. hechi dame?
Illema shekkiddeshah keshehi naara, uvagra. mikkede mita motzia, uvagrut motzia mershut av. ma mita — lo nitrokna reshut labbaal, af bagrut — lo nitrokna reshut labbaal!
Ella shekkiddeshah keshehi bogeret — ha tenena chada zimna: habbogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh?
Ha gufa kashya: amrat habbogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh, bevogeret lema li shenem asar chodesh? bogeret bishloshim yom saggi la! tane: bogeret, vesheshshahata shenem asar chodesh.
Mikkol makom kashya! ibbaet ema: hacha davka, uvogeret katane hatam mishshum devae ippeloge rabbi eliezer verabbanan.
Ibbaet ema: bogeret davka. veayyeyde denasev resha "baze" — nasev sefa name "baze".

a: Mishna nadra vehi arusa. nitgarsha bo bayyom, nitarsa bo bayyom, afillu lemea — aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha. ze hakkelal: kol shello yatza lirshut atzmah shaa achat — aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha.

Gemara menalan dearus acharon mefer nedarim shenniru learus rishon? amar shemuel, amar kera: "veim hayo tihye leish unedareha aleha". nedarim shehayu aleha kevar. dilma hane mille shello niru learus rishon, aval nedarim shenniru learus rishon — la matze mefar arus acharon!
"Aleha" kera yattira hu.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: naara hameorasa — aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha, ketzad? shama aviha vehefer lah, velo hispik habbaal lishmoa ad shemmet, venitarsa bo bayyom, vaafillu mea peamim — aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha. shama balah vehefer lah, velo hispik haav lishmoa ad shemmet habbaal — chozer haav umefer chelko shel baal.
Amar rabbi natan: hen hen divre bet shammay. aval bet hillel omrim: en yachol lehafer. bemay peligi?
b: Bet shammay savri: nedarim name sherauy laarus, nitrokna reshut laav, umiggaz gayez. bet hillel savri: aviha uvalah acharon mefirin nedareha, vela miggaz gayez.
Ibbaya lehu: gerushin kishtika damya, o kahakama damya?
Lemay nafka minna? kegon shennadra veshama balah vegershah, veahdera beyomeh. i amar mar kishtika dame, matze mefar la. vei amar mar kahakama dame, la matze mefar la.

a: Ta shema: ematay amru "met habbaal, nitrokna reshut laav" — bizman shello shama habbaal, o shama vehefer, o shama veshatak umet bo bayyom. vei amrat gerushin kishtika damu, litne name "o shama vegerash"! middela tane hachi — shema minna gerushin kahakama damu.

Ema sefa: aval im shama vekayyaym, o shama veshatak umet beyom shel acharav — en yachol lehafer. vei amrat gerushin kahakama damu, litne "veim shama vegeresh"! ella middela katane hachi, shema minna: gerushin kishtika damu.
Ella meha lekka lemishma minneh. i resha davka — nasev sefa mishshum resha. i sefa davka — nasev resha mishshum sefa.

Ta shema: nadra vehi arusa, venitgarsha venitarsa bo bayyom, afillu lemea — aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha. shema minna gerushin kishtika damu, dei kahakama damu — mi matze mefar arus acharon nidre deokem arus rishon?
Hacha bemay askinan, beshello shama arus rishon. i hachi, may irya bo bayyom? afillu leachar mea yamim name!
Keshello shama arus veshama haav, devo bayyom hu dematze mefar, aval mikkan veelach lo matze mefar.
Ta shema: nadra bo bayyom, gershah vehechzirah bo bayyom — en yachol lehafer. shema minna: gerushin kahakama damu.
Amri: hacha binsua askinan, vehayeynu tama deen yachol lehafer, mishshum deen habbaal mefer bekodmin.
b: Mishna derech talmide chachamim, ad shello hayta bitto yotza meetzlo, omer lah: kol nedarim shennadart betoch beti — hare hen mufarin. vechen habbaal, ad shello tikkanes lirshuto, omer lah: kol nedarim shennadart ad shello tikkansi lirshuti — hare hen mufarin. shemmishshettikkanes lirshuto — eno yachol lehafer.
Gemara bae rame bar chama: baal, mahu sheyyafer belo shemia? "veshama ishah" davka hu, o lav davka hu?
Amar rava, ta shema: derech talmide chachamim, ad shello yatzat bitto meetzlo, omer lah: kol nedarim shennadart betoch beti — hare hen mufarin, veha la shema!
Lechi shama hu demefar. im ken, ki la shema, lema leh lememar? ha kamashma lan: orcheh detzureba merabbanan lehaddore.
Ta shema missefa: vechen habbaal, ad shello tikkanes lirshuto, omer lah. hacha name, deamar la: "lechi shamana".
Ta shema: haomer leishto "kol nedarim shettiddori ad sheavo mimmakom peloni hare hen kayyaymin" — lo amar kelum. "hare hen mufarin", rabbi eliezer omer: mufar. veha la shema.
Hacha name, deamar: "lechi shamana". ulema li min hasheta? lechi shama lefar la! kasavar: dilma mitteridna hahi shata.

Ta shema: haomer leappotroppos "kol nedarim shennoderet ishti mikkan vead sheavo mimmakom peloni hafer", vehefer le, yachol yehu mufarin — talmud lomar: "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu". divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Amar lo rabbi yonatan: matzinu bechol hattora kullah shelucho shel adam kemoto?
Vaafillu rabbi yoshiyya la kaamar ella mishshum digzerat hakkatuv hu "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", aval dechulle alma shelucho shel adam kemoto. veha la shemia leh!

a: Hacha name, deamar leh: lechi shamana mefar la. lechi shama lefar la? hu savar: dilma mitteridna.
Bae rame bar chama: cheresh, mahu sheyyafer leishto? im timtza lomar baal mefer belo shemia — mishshum devar mishma hu, aval cheresh delav bar mishma hu, hayeynu derabbi zera.
Deamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla — en billa meakkevet bo, vechol sheen rauy levilla — billa meakkevet bo.
O dilma: "veshama ishah" la meakkev. amar rava: ta shema "veshama ishah" — perat leeshet cheresh. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: baal, mahu sheyyafer lishte nashav bevat achat? "otah" davka, o lav davka?
Amar ravina, ta shema: en mashkin shete sotot keachat, mippene shellibbah gas bachavertah.
Rabbi yehuda omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum shenneemar "vehishkah" — otah, levaddah.
b: Mishna bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh, vealmana sheloshim yom, rabbi eliezer omer: hoil uvalah chayyayv bimzonoteha — yafer. vachachamim omrim: en habbaal mefer ad shettikkanes lirshuto.

Gemara amar rabba: rabbi eliezer umishna rishona amru davar echad. ditnan: notnin labbetula shenem asar chodesh lefarnes atzmah. higgia shenem asar chodesh — ochelet mishshello, veochelet bitruma. aval hayyavam eno maachil bitruma.

Asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal, veshishsha chodashim bifne hayyavam, vaafillu kullan bifne habbaal chaser yom echad, o kullan bifne hayyavam chaser yom echad — enah ochelet bitruma. zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehem amru: en haishsha ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa.
Amar leh abbaye, dilma la hi: ad kan la ka ashmeinan mishna rishona ella lemechal bitruma derabbanan. aval nedarim deorayyta — ema la.
Vead kan la shamat leh lerabbi eliezer ella gabbe nedarim, kidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava deamar kol hannoderet al daat balah hi noderet. aval teruma — afillu midderabbanan name la achla.

a: Mishna shomeret yavam, ben leyavam echad, ben lishne yevamin. rabbi eliezer omer: yafer. rabbi yehoshua omer: leechad, aval lo lishnayim. rabbi akiva omer: lo leechad velo lishnayim.
Amar rabbi eliezer: ma im ishsha shekkana hu leatzmo — hare hu mefer nedareha, ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim — eno din sheyyafer nedareha?
Amar lo rabbi akiva: lo, im amarta beishsha shekkana hu leatzmo — sheen laacherim bah reshut, tomar beishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim, sheyyesh laacherim bah reshut?!
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: akiva, devarecha bishne yevamin, ma atta meshiv al yavam echad? amar lo: en hayyevama gemura layyavam keshem shehaarusa gemura leishah.
Gemara bishlama rabbi akiva savar en zika, verabbi yehoshua savar yesh zika. ella rabbi eliezer, may tameh? i yesh zika, en berera.
Amar rabbi amme: kegon sheasa bah maamar. verabbi eliezer savar la kevet shammay, deamri: maamar kone kinyan gamur.
Verabbi yehoshua omer lecha: hane mille bechad yavam, aval bishne yevamin — la. mi ikka midde dechi ate achuhi asar aleh bevia, o begitta umefer? verabbi akiva savar: en zika.
Ulerabbi (eliezer) [elazar], deamar: maamar levet shammay en kone ella lidchot batztzara. may ikka lememar?
Hacha bemay askinan — kegon sheamad baddin, veitchayyev lah mezonot, vechidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava: deamar kol hannoderet — al daat balah hi noderet.
b: Tenan amar rabbi eliezer: uma im ishsha shekkana leatzmo — hare hu mefer nedareha, ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim — eno din shemmefer nedareha? vei besheasa bah maamar, kana leatzmo hu! shekkana leatzmo al yede shamayim.
Tifshot devae rabba: maamar levet shammay, erusin ose o nissuin ose? tifshot denissuin ose. dei erusin ose — ha tenan: naara hameorasa, aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may "yafer" — yafer beshuttafut.

Tanya name hachi kerabbi amme: shomeret yavam, ben yavam echad ben shene yevamin, rabbi eliezer omer: yafer, verabbi yehoshua omer: leechad velo lishnayim. rabbi akiva omer: lo leechad velo lishnayim.

Amar rabbi eliezer: uma im ishsha sheen lo chelek bah ad shello tavo lirshuto, mishshebbat lirshuto — nigmera lo. ishsha, sheyyesh lo chelek ad shello tavo lirshuto, mishshebbat lirshuto — eno din shettigmor lo?

Amar lo rabbi akiva: lo, im amarta beishsha shekkana hu leatzmo, shekkeshem sheen lo chelek bah, kach en laacherim chelek bah. tomar beishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim, shekkeshem sheyyesh lo immah chelek — kach yesh laacherim chelek bah!

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: akiva, devarecha — bishne yevamin, ma atta meshiv al yavam echad? amar lo: kelum chillaknu al yavam echad veal shene yevamin ben sheasa bah maamar ben shello asa bah maamar? vechishar devarim ken nedarim.
Ballashon hazze amar ben azzay: chaval alecha ben azzay shello shimmashta et rabbi akiva.
May

a: Tanya kevoteh derabbi amme? dekatane: ben sheasa bah maamar uven shello asa bah maamar.
I name meresha dekatane: mishshennichnesa lirshuto nigmera lo. vei dela kaddesh, may "nigmera lo"? tifshot minneh kesheasa bah maamar.
May "vechishar devarim ken nedarim" dekatane? amar rava, hachi katane: i atta mode sheen chayyayvin sekila, kenaara hameorasa?
Amar rav ashe, matnitin name dayka: en yevama gemura leishah keshem shearusa gemura leishah.

Mishna haomer leishto "kol hannedarim shettiddori mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni hare hen kayyaymin" — lo amar kelum. "hare hen mufarin" — rabbi eliezer omer: mufar, vachachamim omrim: eno mufar. amar rabbi eliezer: im hefer nedarim shebbau lichlal issur — lo yafer nedarim shello bau lichlal issur?!
Amru lo: hare hu omer "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu". et shebba lichlal hakem — ba lichlal hafer, lo ba lichlal hakem — lo ba lichlal hafer.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: lerabbi eliezer mechal chalin uvatlin, o dilma la chalin kelal? lemay nafka minna,
b: Kegon deatpes acharina behaden nidra. i amrat chalin — havya tefisuta. i amrat la chalin — la ikka meshasha.
May? ta shema, amar rabbi eliezer: im hefer nedarim shebbau lichlal issur, lo yafer nedarim shello bau lichlal issur? shema minna la chalin!
Mi katane "sheenan bain"? "shello bau" katane, adayin lo bau.

Ta shema, amar lahen rabbi eliezer: uma bimkom sheen mefer nidre atzmo mishshennadar, mefer nidre atzmo ad shello yadur. mekom shemmefer nidre ishto mishshettiddor, eno din sheyyafer nidre ishto ad shello tiddor?
May lav, deishto dumeya dileh, ma [hu] dela chayylin — af ishto name dela chayylin? la, ha kidita veha kidita.

Ta shema, amru lo lerabbi eliezer: uma mikve shemmaale et hattemein mittumeatan — en matztzil al hattehorim millittame, adam sheen maale et hattemein mittumeatan — eno din hu shello yatztzil al hattehorin millittame?
Shema minna la chayylin!
